identity.name: Meeting Insights Analyser
identity.description: Parses a meeting transcript (Teams/Zoom/Otter) into a structured artefact: decisions, action items with owners and due dates, open questions, and a one-paragraph summary. Outputs both Markdown and a JSON object suitable for an action-tracker.

capability.summary: Extract decisions and actions from a meeting transcript

inputs.name: transcript
inputs.description: Plain text or VTT transcript.

scoring.rationale: LLM extraction; output is advisory and reviewed by the meeting owner before circulation.

identity.name: Content Research Writer
identity.description: Drafts a long-form research article (1500-3000 words) from a topic brief: gathers sources via web search, builds an outline, drafts sections with citations, and outputs Markdown plus a bibliography. Human-in-the-loop expected before publish.

capability.summary: Draft a long-form research article from a topic brief

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: Article topic and angle.

inputs.name: audience
inputs.description: Target audience description.

scoring.rationale: LLM-generated content; subject to hallucination — bibliography lets reviewers verify before publishing.

identity.name: Canvas Design
identity.description: Composes a visual canvas (poster, social card, single-page graphic) from a structured brief: background, headline, body, imagery placement, palette. Outputs SVG + rasterised PNG. Originally an Anthropic Agent Skill.

capability.summary: Render a canvas graphic from a structured design brief

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: Structured design brief: layout, copy, palette, imagery.

scoring.rationale: Visual output may vary subtly; safe to regenerate.

identity.name: Frontend Design
identity.description: Generates production-quality React + Tailwind component code from a screen brief: header, hero, feature grid, footer. Output is ready to drop into a Next.js app. Originally an Anthropic Agent Skill.

capability.summary: Generate React + Tailwind UI from a screen brief

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: Sections, copy, intended call-to-action.

inputs.name: tokens
inputs.description: Optional design tokens to honour (output of design/theme-factory).

outputs.name: components
outputs.description: TSX files keyed by component name.

scoring.rationale: Generated code; reviewable before commit.

identity.name: Theme Factory
identity.description: Produces a consistent UI theme (colour ramp, type scale, spacing, radii) from a small input: brand name, vibe words, primary colour. Returns design-token JSON usable by Tailwind, MUI or raw CSS variables. Originally an Anthropic Agent Skill.

capability.summary: Generate a coherent UI theme as design tokens

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: Brand name, vibe words, primary colour (hex).

scoring.rationale: Output is design-only; safe to regenerate and replace.

identity.name: Changelog Generator
identity.description: Generates a Keep-a-Changelog-formatted CHANGELOG entry from a git commit range. Groups commits by Conventional-Commit type (feat/fix/docs/chore), de-duplicates by PR, and produces a markdown block ready to paste under a new version heading.

capability.summary: Generate a changelog entry from a git commit range

inputs.name: repoPath
inputs.description: Local path to the git repository.

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: Git revision range, e.g. 'v1.2.0..HEAD'.

scoring.rationale: Reads git history; produces a markdown string. No external writes.

identity.name: MCP Server Builder
identity.description: Scaffolds a FastMCP-based Python MCP server from a tool-list specification: server entry point, tool stubs, transport wiring (stdio + streamable-http), Dockerfile, and a pytest skeleton. Originally an Anthropic Agent Skill.

capability.summary: Scaffold a FastMCP server from a tool spec

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: List of tools with names, descriptions and input schemas.

inputs.name: targetDirectory
inputs.description: Where to write the scaffold.

outputs.name: files
outputs.description: Map of file paths to generated contents.

scoring.rationale: Generates code only; output is reviewable before commit.

identity.name: Skill Creator
identity.description: Guided authoring of a new Skill manifest + SKILL.md payload, including schema validation and capability-tag suggestions. Wraps the Register-gate workflow so a maker can ship a new skill in minutes without memorising the schema.

capability.summary: Author a schema-valid Skill manifest and payload

inputs.name: intent
inputs.description: Natural-language description of what the new skill should do.

inputs.name: ownerHandle
inputs.description: Accountable owner identity.

scoring.rationale: Produces a draft artifact only. Human approval at Certify gate prevents low-quality skills from being published.

identity.name: Web App Testing
identity.description: Drives a real browser (Playwright) to test web applications: navigation, form filling, assertion of visible state, screenshot capture, network-request inspection. Useful for smoke-testing a deployed app or as a CI verification step.

capability.summary: Execute browser-based tests against a web app

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: Entry URL to the application under test.

inputs.name: scenario
inputs.description: Ordered list of steps (navigate, click, type, assert).

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Pass/fail per step, screenshots, console logs, network requests.

scoring.rationale: Browses real systems; can submit forms or trigger emails if scenario includes write actions. Risk depends on the scenario.

identity.name: Accounts Payable Intake
identity.description: Composite skill: takes an inbound invoice document, extracts its fields, matches it to a purchase order, and returns a payment-ready packet or an exception for human review. Demonstrates runtime composition from certified skills.

capability.summary: End-to-end AP intake: document in, payment-ready packet or exception out

inputs.name: document
inputs.description: Inbound invoice document.

scoring.rationale: Inherits medium risk from po-match; orchestration adds variability so determinism is medium. No ledger posting.

identity.name: Invoice Field Extractor
identity.description: Extracts structured fields (vendor, invoice number, line items, totals, dates) from a PDF or image invoice. Deterministic OCR + rules pipeline; use it when you need machine-readable invoice data.

capability.summary: Extract structured fields from an invoice document

inputs.name: document
inputs.description: PDF or image of a single invoice.

outputs.name: fields
outputs.description: Vendor, number, dates, line items, totals.

scoring.rationale: Read-only extraction; no state changes. Output is verifiable against the source document.

identity.name: Invoice Field Extractor v2 (deliberate duplicate)
identity.description: Smoke-test manifest. Deliberately collides with finance/invoice-extract on capabilityTags and IOPE signature so the validate-manifests workflow's duplicate scan must reject it.

capability.summary: Extract structured fields from an invoice document (duplicate of finance/invoice-extract)

inputs.name: document
inputs.description: PDF or image of a single invoice.

outputs.name: fields
outputs.description: Vendor, number, dates, line items, totals.

scoring.rationale: Smoke-test only; not intended for use.

identity.name: Invoice Organizer
identity.description: Sorts a folder of mixed invoice files into per-supplier, per-month subfolders; renames to a canonical scheme (YYYY-MM_<supplier>_<number>.<ext>); and emits a CSV index. Pairs naturally with finance/invoice-extract.

capability.summary: Sort and rename a folder of invoices to a canonical scheme

inputs.name: inputDirectory
inputs.description: Folder containing mixed invoice files.

outputs.name: index
outputs.description: CSV of original path → new path with extracted supplier/month/number.

scoring.rationale: Moves and renames files; reversible via the emitted CSV index but disruptive if run on wrong directory.

identity.name: Purchase Order Matcher
identity.description: Matches extracted invoice fields against open purchase orders and flags 2-way/3-way match exceptions. Use after invoice fields are available.

capability.summary: Match invoice fields to purchase orders and flag exceptions

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Structured invoice fields.

outputs.name: matchResult
outputs.description: Matched PO id or list of exceptions.

scoring.rationale: Writes a match record but does not post to the ledger; medium risk because an incorrect match can route a payment for review.

identity.name: Legal MSA Redlining
identity.description: Drafts, reviews, and redlines Master Service Agreements (MSAs) calibrated to the governing jurisdiction. Applies region-specific legal standards (UK GDPR, EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, APAC data laws, LATAM LGPD/LFPDPPP, MEA PDPL) to all relevant clauses and produces a Word document with tracked-change-style redline markup or a clean new draft. Always emits a Negotiation Summary cover page with risk-grouped findings and a legal-review disclaimer.

capability.summary: Draft or redline a Master Service Agreement with region-specific legal standards

inputs.name: region
inputs.description: Governing region or jurisdiction (e.g. UK, EU, US-California, Singapore, Brazil). If omitted and an uploaded MSA exists, region is inferred from the governing-law clause; otherwise the agent asks once.

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: One of: 'new-draft', 'redline', 'compare'.

inputs.name: uploaded_msa
inputs.description: Existing MSA to redline. Required for task='redline'.

inputs.name: second_version
inputs.description: Second MSA version. Required for task='compare'.

outputs.name: agreement
outputs.description: Word document containing the new draft, the redlined version, or the side-by-side comparison.

outputs.name: negotiation_summary
outputs.description: Cover-page summary: region, clauses reviewed, top-3 high-risk items, legal-review disclaimer.

scoring.rationale: LLM-drafted legal text; subject to hallucination and jurisdictional nuance. All output is advisory — every deliverable carries a mandatory disclaimer recommending qualified legal review before execution. Risk is high because contracts have real legal effect; mitigation is the disclaimer, placeholder convention, and ⚠ LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED markers on high-risk clauses.

identity.name: Word (DOCX) Toolkit
identity.description: Create, edit, format and inspect Microsoft Word documents. Wraps python-docx so an agent can author letters, reports and policy documents with headings, tables, images and styles. Originally an Anthropic Agent Skill.

capability.summary: Author and edit Microsoft Word documents

inputs.name: document
inputs.description: Optional existing DOCX to edit; omit to create from scratch.

inputs.name: instructions
inputs.description: Structured edits or generation spec (headings, paragraphs, tables, styles).

scoring.rationale: Generates a new document; does not mutate external systems.

identity.name: PDF Toolkit
identity.description: Read, extract text and tables from, split, merge, and fill forms in PDF files. Wraps pdfplumber/pypdf/reportlab so a host agent can manipulate PDFs without learning library specifics. Anthropic-authored Agent Skill ported as a deterministic-tool manifest.

capability.summary: Read, extract, modify and fill PDF documents

inputs.name: document
inputs.description: PDF file (binary or URL).

inputs.name: operation
inputs.description: One of: extract_text, extract_tables, fill_form, split, merge.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Extracted text/tables, modified PDF bytes, or operation status.

scoring.rationale: Pure file manipulation; no external state changes. Operations on a copy of the input.

identity.name: PowerPoint (PPTX) Toolkit
identity.description: Generate, edit and template PowerPoint presentations. Wraps python-pptx so an agent can build slide decks with title slides, bullet content, tables, charts and images from structured input. Originally an Anthropic Agent Skill.

capability.summary: Generate and edit PowerPoint presentations

inputs.name: template
inputs.description: Optional template; omit to use a default deck.

inputs.name: deck
inputs.description: Ordered list of slide specs (title, layout, content).

scoring.rationale: Builds a new deck deterministically from the input spec.

identity.name: Excel (XLSX) Toolkit
identity.description: Read, write, analyse and chart Excel workbooks. Wraps openpyxl/pandas for cell access, named-range lookup, formula evaluation, and chart insertion. Originally an Anthropic Agent Skill; manifest provided so it is discoverable via the registry.

capability.summary: Read, write and analyse Excel workbooks

inputs.name: workbook
inputs.description: XLSX file (binary or URL).

inputs.name: operation
inputs.description: One of: read_range, write_range, add_chart, evaluate_formulas, list_sheets.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Cell values, modified workbook bytes, or operation status.

scoring.rationale: Read/write operates on the supplied workbook; no external systems touched.

identity.name: File Organizer
identity.description: Bulk-classifies a directory tree by content type (docs, images, code, archives, media) and proposes a target layout with a dry-run preview before any move executes. Useful for taming Downloads folders and project workspaces.

capability.summary: Classify and re-layout a directory tree

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Directory to organise.

inputs.name: applyChanges
inputs.description: If false (default), returns a dry-run plan only.

scoring.rationale: Dry-run by default. When applied, the plan is the reversal manifest.

identity.name: Tailored Resume Generator
identity.description: Customises a base resume to a specific job description: re-orders bullets by relevance, suggests rewordings against the job's keywords, and outputs both a DOCX and a tracked-changes diff for human review.

capability.summary: Tailor a resume to a target job description

inputs.name: baseResume
inputs.description: Source resume.

inputs.name: jobDescription
inputs.description: Target job description.

scoring.rationale: LLM-mediated rewording; output reviewed by human before use.

identity.name: Competitive Ads Extractor
identity.description: Given a competitor's name or domain, pulls their currently-running ads from public ad-library sources (Meta Ad Library, Google Transparency Centre) and structures them: copy, creative URL, audience, observed dates. Useful for marketing intelligence.

capability.summary: Extract a competitor's live ads from public ad libraries

inputs.name: competitor
inputs.description: Competitor name or domain.

scoring.rationale: Read-only fetch from public ad-library APIs and pages.

identity.name: Lead Research Assistant
identity.description: Builds a structured dossier on a sales lead from a company name and (optionally) a contact name: public funding history, recent news, technology fingerprint, decision-maker LinkedIn pointers. Read-only across public sources.

capability.summary: Compile a structured dossier on a sales lead

inputs.name: company
inputs.description: Company name.

inputs.name: contact
inputs.description: Named contact, if any.

scoring.rationale: Aggregates public web data; quality varies. Sources cited for verification.
